findings.title: Durable source snapshot becomes ineffective when capture cursor advances
findings.actual: Page 1 success; legitimate cursor revision 1 -> 2; page 2 identical canonical URL/upstream ID/body returns STALE_INPUT. Direct sealSourceBytes in rolled-back diagnostic transaction reproduces it. Distinct page items succeed.
findings.cause: SOURCE_SNAPSHOT input_refs includes mutable SourceCursor revision; canonical content reuse recursively checks old cursor as current semantic input.

findings.title: Identical source page replay violates Evidence idempotence
findings.actual: Second identical page capture without cursor advance returns SQLite evidence_snapshot UNIQUE constraint failure (2067).
findings.cause: createEvidence always creates new identity despite canonical URL/upstream revision/snapshot hash unique contract.
